aws_s3_bucket.description: S3 bucket allows public read access
aws_s3_bucket.impact: Bucket contents are publicly accessible, leading to data exposure
aws_s3_bucket.resolution: Set ACL to 'private' or use bucket policies for specific access

aws_s3_bucket.description: S3 bucket allows public write access
aws_s3_bucket.impact: Anyone can upload malicious content or delete data
aws_s3_bucket.resolution: Set ACL to 'private' and use IAM policies for write access

aws_s3_bucket.description: S3 bucket does not have default encryption enabled
aws_s3_bucket.impact: Data stored in bucket is not encrypted at rest
aws_s3_bucket.resolution: Enable server-side encryption with AES-256 or KMS

aws_s3_bucket.description: S3 bucket versioning is not enabled
aws_s3_bucket.impact: Cannot recover from accidental deletion or modification
aws_s3_bucket.resolution: Enable versioning on the S3 bucket

aws_security_group.description: Security group allows unrestricted SSH access (0.0.0.0/0)
aws_security_group.impact: SSH port is exposed to the entire internet, increasing brute force risk
aws_security_group.resolution: Restrict SSH access to specific IP addresses or use VPN

aws_security_group.description: Security group allows unrestricted RDP access (0.0.0.0/0)
aws_security_group.impact: RDP port exposed to internet allows unauthorized remote access attempts
aws_security_group.resolution: Restrict RDP to specific trusted IP ranges

aws_alb_listener.description: ALB listener does not use HTTPS
aws_alb_listener.impact: Traffic is transmitted in plaintext, exposing sensitive data
aws_alb_listener.resolution: Use HTTPS protocol with valid SSL/TLS certificates

aws_elb_listener.description: ELB listener does not use HTTPS
aws_elb_listener.impact: Traffic is transmitted in plaintext, exposing sensitive data
aws_elb_listener.resolution: Use HTTPS protocol with valid SSL/TLS certificates

aws_db_instance.description: RDS instance does not have encryption enabled
aws_db_instance.impact: Database data at rest is not encrypted
aws_db_instance.resolution: Enable storage encryption for RDS instances

aws_db_instance.impact: Database is exposed to the internet

aws_db_instance.description: RDS instance does not have automated backups enabled
aws_db_instance.impact: Cannot recover from data loss or corruption
aws_db_instance.resolution: Set backup_retention_period to at least 7 days

aws_iam_role_policy.impact: Role has overly permissive access to all AWS services
aws_iam_role_policy.resolution: Use specific actions instead of wildcards

azurerm_storage_account.description: Azure Storage Account allows public access
Storage Account does not enforce HTTPS-only traffic
azurerm_storage_account.impact: Data can be transmitted over unencrypted HTTP connections

azurerm_storage_account.description: Storage Account does not have encryption enabled
azurerm_storage_account.impact: Data at rest is not encrypted

azurerm_network_security_group.description: NSG allows unrestricted SSH access from internet
azurerm_network_security_group.impact: SSH exposed to internet increases unauthorized access risk
azurerm_network_security_group.resolution: Restrict source addresses to specific IPs or ranges

azurerm_sql_database.description: Azure SQL Database does not have TDE enabled
azurerm_sql_database.impact: Database files are not encrypted at rest

azurerm_key_vault.description: Key Vault allows public network access
azurerm_key_vault.impact: Secrets and keys are accessible from public internet
azurerm_key_vault.resolution: Set default_action to Deny and use private endpoints

google_storage_bucket.description: GCP Storage Bucket allows public access
google_storage_bucket.impact: Bucket contents may be publicly accessible
google_storage_bucket.resolution: Enable uniform bucket-level access and review IAM bindings

google_storage_bucket.description: Storage Bucket does not use customer-managed encryption
google_storage_bucket.impact: Data encrypted with Google-managed keys only

google_compute_firewall.description: Firewall rule allows unrestricted SSH from internet
google_compute_firewall.impact: SSH exposed to all of internet
google_compute_firewall.resolution: Restrict source_ranges to trusted IP addresses

google_compute_firewall.description: Firewall rule allows unrestricted RDP from internet
google_compute_firewall.impact: RDP exposed to all of internet
google_compute_firewall.resolution: Restrict source_ranges to trusted IP addresses

google_sql_database_instance.description: Cloud SQL instance has public IP enabled
google_sql_database_instance.resolution: Disable public IP and use private IP or Cloud SQL Proxy

google_sql_database_instance.description: Cloud SQL instance does not have automated backups

google_container_cluster.impact: Cluster uses less secure authentication mechanisms
google_container_cluster.resolution: Disable legacy authentication and use workload identity

google_container_cluster.description: GKE cluster does not have network policy enabled
google_container_cluster.resolution: Enable network policy for pod-to-pod traffic control
